key_findings.sft_format: Klear-AgentForge (arXiv 2511.05951, official usage of Klear-66k) trains on a SINGLE unified scaffold format, no harness mixing; PIPE (arXiv 2602.01611) shows trajectory-SFT mostly teaches interface familiarity and degrades under interface rewrites; Open-SWE-Traces (arXiv 2606.16038, NVIDIA) studies cross-harness generalization
key_findings.sft_curation: SWE-Prime (arXiv 2608.27449): 10% curated subset beats full resolved set (+12.2% rel); SWE-Gym (arXiv 2412.21139): rejection-sampling SFT
key_findings.context_length: DeepSWE (arXiv 2508.17146): gains beyond 32k context ~2% (16k->128k ablation); long-context SWE agents (arXiv 2508.03501) run RL from 65k; our 2-4 card budget realistically caps ~32k - acceptable per DeepSWE saturation
key_findings.rl_recipe: AgentForge RL = GRPO with KL removed, DAPO asymmetric clip, truncated IS, truncation oversample+mask; slime official SWE recipe (8x8 GPUs): eps-clip 0.2/0.28, kl-loss-coef 0, colocate, CPU optimizer offload, harness-side auto-compact
key_findings.scale_reality: smallest public success configs are 8-node x 8-GPU class even for 8B models; our 2-4xH100 is far below public practice - expect small batches/few steps; OPD sample-efficiency is the differentiation (SOD: GRPO fails at 0.6B where OPD works)
key_findings.opd_risk: OPD survey (arXiv 2604.00626): aggressive reverse-KL raises Pass@1 but degrades Pass@k - conflicts with GRPO group diversity; opd-kl-coef needs tuning with group-reward-variance monitoring (any change requires user consent)
key_findings.eval_gap: SWE-bench Verified official harness REQUIRES Docker (x86_64, >=120GB storage, 16GB RAM, 8 cores); the platform docker-proxy probe failed 2026-09-09 (cannot use job_queue) - platform-layer blocker to resolve before the eval stage; Epoch AI optimized images exist but third-party images deviate from the official protocol
